**The weapon picks up the room around it.** The relit weapon now takes its
light from what surrounds the player, not just from nearby lamps: a soft fill
from every side, and its glossy metal and outline mirror what lies that way.
Walk toward a bright wall or window and the light creeps in over the gun's
silhouette, even in places no lamp reaches; in a dark corridor it stays dark.
The top of the barrel catches broad highlights from bright panels ahead.

**Window light is more natural.** Rooms with windows on several sides no
longer get lit past the outdoor level by all of them adding up. Windows onto
a sunny courtyard now light the room more than windows onto shade, so the
sunny side of a room leads. Indoor spots beside openings no longer get an extra
sky brightening on top of the window light.

**Lamp-lit rooms don't go too dark.** Darkening rooms around their lamps and
windows now stops before any floor spot drops below 60% of its light level
(before, E1M1 and E1M2 had some floors at under half), and window frames at
the outdoor light level are no longer dimmed along with the room inside.
